risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with detailed revenue, margin, bookings, backlog, restructuring, and segment data. Risk tone is cautiously positive overall, although declining Refrigeration & Food Equipment demand, rising material costs, facility inefficiencies, divestitures, and ongoing restructuring present identifiable risks. Standard forward-looking and non-GAAP disclaimers add limited boilerplate but do not materially obscure the financial information.
